title: cnidoscolus longipes
intro: Cnidoscolus longipes, commonly known as the "wild spinach" or "bitter melon," is a species of flowering plant in the family Euphorbiaceae. This plant is known for its edible leaves, which have been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and digestive issues. The health benefits of Cnidoscolus longipes include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against chronic diseases such as cancer and diabetes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of anti-cancer, anti-diabetic, and anti-inflammatory effects.
